data: What is the accuracy of the blue line when the training data size is 50% in the left graph?

In the left graph, the x-axis shows the training data size in percentage, and the y-axis shows the accuracy. At approximately 50% on the x-axis, the blue line reaches an accuracy value of around 0.94. Therefore, the accuracy of the blue line when the training data size is 50% is approximately 0.94.
